scientific_scope: Stock O1 v11 high-churn repeated-ID *synthetic* 400-slot 3-day fixture, single concurrent client; RAW UUID improved two selective controls materially beyond baseline drift; broad query gains less certain.

fixture.note: One record per logical series with multiple samples. Synthetic fixed 3h lifetimes; not real telemetry, HPA, counter-reset, SLA or tenant access workload.

run.runner: ubuntu-24.04 4 logical CPUs, AMD EPYC 7763, 16GB runner memory, ClickHouse server memory max 4.8e9 bytes

intervention.baseline: TimeSeries v11 stock ID Tuple(UInt64,LowCardinality(UUID)) in TAGS/SAMPLES/TimeRanges
intervention.candidate: TimeSeries v11 explicit Tuple(UInt64,UUID) in all three inner tables; same id hash, same tags index and sample input
intervention.layout: two tables on same stock O1 executable; each inner target one active part after OPTIMIZE FINAL; merges stopped during queries; no recent samples target
intervention.native_expression: avg by(project or namespace)(avg_over_time(tslab_node_cpu_ratio or tslab_pod_cpu_ratio{matching labels}[1d])) via prometheusQueryRange, 3 daily points per group
intervention.method: For each of 4 selectors, A/B/B/A LC/RAW/RAW/LC, each phase 2 warmups and 6 measured queries, same process and fixture, full label/timestamp equality + numeric tolerance 1e-10/1e-8, same logical ID digest and exact sample element count
intervention.source_safety_note: LowCardinality dictionary decode path checks indexes in stock. Unrelated staged C++ fast-path bypass audited but not included.

storage.note: Compressed on-disk totals for this fixture only; RAW smaller by about 1.92%, not 1.92% improvement in all workloads.

node_broad.interpretation: weak: improvement close to baseline drift

pod_namespace.interpretation: positive narrow evidence; 13.5% improvement vs 1.5% A/A drift

pod_broad.interpretation: weak: improvement close to baseline drift

burst15.interpretation: positive narrow evidence; 15.8% improvement vs 2.6% drift

limitations: Source trace CPU categories were measured from ONE representative query per variant, not median CPU-share attribution; no mutex contention proved.

The experimental workload has constant 3h node lifetimes synchronized on UTC boundaries, no HPA, ACL, Kafka, real VictoriaMetrics or mixed tenants. Another agent's fixture handles HPA/streaming, do not replace.
One concurrent client only; no QPS, p99 capacity, 14d, HPA write amplification or cold-cache distribution proof.
A/B/B/A controls below the 25% predefined rejection threshold; gains near A/A drift are weak and not promoted.
RSS is sampled at 4Hz; on subsecond queries observed maxima are not guaranteed true process RSS peak.
No conclusion on production jemalloc allocator; these experiments used the stock O1 lab binary.

invalid_prior_run.why: Bench asserted 2,488,320 points equals 86,688 physical SAMPLES bucket rows. C++ v11 stores Array(Tuple(timestamp,value)) per hourly bucket; incorrect assertion, not data bug. Rerun replaces gate with sum(length(samples)).

next_action: Pre-register controlled 2x3 TimeSeries samples_bucket_step_seconds=900/3600/10800 x LC/RAW factorial with same fixture, exact native parity, new-table ingest/merge costs, physical bucket rows, p50/p95 CPU and memory, matched controls. Only consider after checking live claims/CI. Parallel Kubernetes HPA fixture is complementary.
stop_condition: Do not promote a global ID type or production setting until a 14d/HPA/retention/concurrency/write and allocator parity matrix passes. Any broad query OOM/correctness mismatch rejects candidate.
